title: Tracks from real roads
caption: Assetto Corsa tracks built from OpenStreetMap geometry and USGS elevation, from the first marked-up aerial to the installed Lake Murray v3.

files.caption: Sand Creek Raceway, the first input to the pipeline: a marked-up aerial of a street loop in Commerce City. "The screenshot is a selection aid, not data."
Lookout Lariat, first drive: Praga R1 at the start line at night, streetlamps placed by the engine. Real road, placeholder trees.
Six hours later, a 650 GT3 on the grass at Lookout Lariat. The kind of frame that becomes a ledger entry.
Lake Murray, the August build: real road and elevation, sketch-quality scenery with wireframe palms and black blobs for trees. Later filed as ledger 0040, "trees and lamps are placeholders."
IMI Motorsports, a circuit port where OpenStreetMap had nothing usable, so the asphalt was traced from a georeferenced aerial.
Lake Murray v3 street loop: Alvarado, College, Navajo, Jackson, Lake Murray Blvd. Three layouts from one 116 MB model with fourteen tree species and AI lines for each direction.
